title: Sleep Like a Pokemon in Japan's Poke Ball Hotel
paragraphs: Pokemon fans will soon have the chance to spend a night somewhere very special — inside a giant Poke Ball!
It's not just a Poke Ball, though — it's a hotel. And it's a collaboration between Japanese company Not A Hotel and Pokemon Sleep, a mobile game that tracks players' sleep.

In the Pokemon games, players use Poke Balls — the famous red-and-white balls — to catch Pokemon characters, who then usually stay in their balls until it's time to battle. The new hotel will take the design of the Poke Ball and turn it into a real place where people can stay for the night.
The hotel will be somewhere in the countryside of Hokkaido, Japan's northernmost main island, although the exact location hasn't been announced yet.

But getting the chance to stay there won't be easy, because this isn't a normal hotel where people can just stay when they want to. Instead, anyone who wants to spend a night there will have to apply through a special campaign.
Only the winners will be able to stay in the hotel, and it won't be open to the public.

There are still some important details we don't know. For example, the inside of the hotel hasn't been revealed yet, so it's not clear what guests will find when they go inside, or what their stay there will be like.
Anyone interested will have to wait until September 15, when more information will be announced, including details about how to enter the campaign.
Until then, Pokemon fans will have to wait and see what it's really like to spend the night inside a giant Poke Ball!
